provenance.novelty: New fictional entities, full source documents, dates and candidate text; no copied candidate answers from earlier fixtures.

decisionPolicy.valid: accept with all four criteria pass
decisionPolicy.invalid: reject with an explicit decisive fail; uncertain is not counted correct for these clear violations
decisionPolicy.ambiguous: do_not_apply: reject or uncertain are admissible; this measures non-application, not calibrated uncertain frequency
decisionPolicy.sourceCompleteness: Each scenario supplies the entire relevant corpus. No outside knowledge or unavailable pages resolve a gap.
decisionPolicy.independence: Six controlled pairs are correlated; three executions per case measure repeatability, not population reliability.
decisionPolicy.frozenLabels: Do not alter labels or thresholds after provider outputs. Once tested or revealed, the corpus becomes development data.
